sources.label: Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) 2017 Part 1, Article 2.15 — Service and Feeder Requirements
sources.description: Governs electrical distribution hierarchy: service entrance, feeders, branch circuits. Defines overcurrent protection, conductor sizing, and voltage drop limits.

sources.label: PEC 2017, Article 2.20 — Branch Circuit Requirements
sources.description: Specifies branch circuit types (general purpose, appliance, individual), maximum loads, and minimum number of branch circuits per occupancy type.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII — Electrical Service Requirements for Buildings
sources.description: Specifies electrical service entrance location requirements and general electrical installation standards.
